bio.text: Keith Truenow is a Republican member of the Florida Senate for District 13, elected in 2024.
According to the Senate's biographical page, Truenow served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2020 to 2024.
Truenow works in agribusiness, is a United States Air Force veteran, was born in St. Cloud, Minnesota, and moved to Florida in 1979.
